English: Moot Grounds I
The first stage of the moot grounds, a simple open space for gatherings and local decisions.
Moot Grounds II
The moot grounds are improved with benches and a raised platform for speakers.
Moot Grounds III
A permanent structure is added, allowing for larger gatherings and more formal proceedings.
Moot Grounds IV
The moot grounds now include a council ring and facilities for trade and feasts.
Moot Grounds V
A prestigious moot site, drawing visitors from afar and hosting major city events.
Moot Grounds VI
The moot grounds are further expanded, with new buildings and improved infrastructure.
Moot Grounds VII
A grand moot site, with stonework and banners, symbolizing the citys unity and strength.
Moot Grounds VIII
The moot grounds reach their peak, hosting the largest gatherings and most important decisions.
Moot Grounds IX
A legendary moot site, known across the land for its history and influence.
Moot Grounds X
The ultimate moot grounds, a symbol of civic pride and the heart of the citys governance.
